params.name: pdl_id
params.description: The PDL ID of the company to enrich.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the company.

params.name: profile
params.description: A social profile of the company (linkedin/facebook/twitter/crunchbase).

params.name: ticker
params.description: The company's stock ticker, if publicly traded.

params.name: website
params.description: A website the company uses.

params.name: location
params.description: The location of the company's headquarters. This can be anything from a street address to a country name.

params.name: street_address
params.description: The company HQ's street address.

params.name: locality
params.description: The company HQ's locality. e.g. San Francisco

params.name: region
params.description: The company HQ's region. e.g. California

params.name: country
params.description: The company HQ's country.

params.name: postal_code
params.description: The company HQ's postal code.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Whether the output should have human-readable indentation.

params.name: titlecase
params.description: All text in API responses returns as lowercase by default. Setting titlecase to true will titlecase response data instead.

params.name: include_if_matched
params.description: If true, the response will include the top-level field matched that contains a list of every input that matched this profile.

params.name: min_likelihood
params.description: The minimum likelihood score a response must possess in order to return a 200.

params.name: required
params.description: The fields a response must have in order to count as a match.

params.name: query
params.description: An Elasticsearch (v7.7) query. See our underlying Elasticsearch mapping for reference.

params.name: sql
params.description: A SQL query of the format: SELECT * FROM company WHERE XXX, where XXX is a standard SQL boolean query involving PDL fields. Any use of column selections or the LIMIT keyword will be ignored.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of matched records to return for this query if they exist*. Must be between 1 and 100

params.name: from
params.description: An offset value for pagination. Can be a number between 0 and 9999. Pagination can be executed up to a maximum of 10,000 records per query. Be sure to use the "total" response field to help discover how many total records exist in the dataset for your query

params.name: scroll_token
params.description: Setting titlecase to true will titlecase any records returned

params.description: Setting titlecase to true will titlecase any records returned

params.description: Whether the output should have human-readable indentation.
